title: 第 2章 这水心经被改了十七版？
novel_title: 宗门收徒，我能看见属性词条
content_zh:
李应灵无理的要求自然被楚星尘反驳了回去。

    系统提供的心法那都是能够完美成仙的修行功法。

    还是完美适配灵根的那种。

    大仙门都不一定有，能让李应灵修就偷着乐吧，还敢挑三拣四。

    主要是自己也没别的修仙心法给这丫头练。

    夜晚。

    李应灵躺在冰冷冷的木板上，没有家里酥软的枕头，她真的很难睡着啊。

    虽然身上穿着衣服，但没有被子盖住自己的小肚子，她觉得浑身不适应。

    李应灵轻声喊道：“师父。”

    楚星尘没好气的回答传来：

    “大晚上不睡觉做什么？”

    “破庙门口漏风……我冷。”

    楚星尘打着哈欠道：“起来走两步，不冷了再去睡。”

    李应灵弱弱的反驳：“那不是躺一会又冷了？”

    楚星尘有些无奈道：“跟你说了，那本心法叫无上太阴真玄灵水心经，你大胆练就完了！”

    “炼气三四层左右你就不会冷了。”

    李应灵默默侧目看向和自己躺在一块的神功秘籍——水心经。

    师父！你说的这话真的很难让人信服啊！！

    干！死就死！自己选的师父，含着泪也要修下去。

    李应灵咬牙起身，拿起那本水心经走到火堆旁，翻开第一页，看向第一行。

    【本座水灵真君，该心法是真仙境水灵真君独家绝学。】

    霍！真仙心法？

    李应灵心情略好的看向第二行。

    【本座怒涛真君，水灵真君写的真水！本座已修改！效果更猛，大家放心修炼！】

    霍！还有大能贴心修改？！

    李应灵满意的点头目光再看向第三行。

    【本座翻海真君，上面两个都是废物，写的什么玩意，误人子弟！本座已改。】

    ………？？？？

    李应灵目光迅速扫过第一页。

    好家伙！

    第一页全是本座开头，怒斥上面废物的句子，按照第一页的说法。

    这本水心经至少被十七位大能给改过。

    也就是说这是经过十七个版本的修仙心法。

    李应灵颤颤巍巍的翻开下一页。

    千万别再改了！

    【本座……】

    李应灵只觉眼睛一黑，但还是忍耐一手看了下去。
content_en:
Li Yingling's unreasonable request was naturally refuted by Chu Xingchen.

The mental methods provided by the system are all cultivation methods that can perfectly achieve immortality.

It is still the kind that perfectly adapts to spiritual roots.

Even the Great Immortal Sect may not have one, so just let Li Ying practice his spiritual practice secretly, and dare to be picky.

The main reason is that I don't have any other cultivation techniques for this girl to practice.

night.

Li Yingling was lying on the cold wooden board. Without the soft pillow at home, it was really difficult for her to fall asleep.

Although she was wearing clothes, there was no quilt covering her belly, and she felt uncomfortable.

Li Yingling shouted softly: "Master."

Chu Xingchen's angry reply came:

"What are you doing if you don't sleep at night?"

"There is draft at the door of the ruined temple...I'm cold."

Chu Xingchen yawned and said, "Get up and take a few steps, then go to sleep when the cold is gone."

Li Yingling retorted weakly: "Didn't you get cold again after lying down for a while?"

Chu Xingchen said helplessly: "I told you, the heart method is called the Supreme Taiyin Zhenxuan Lingshui Heart Sutra. Just practice it boldly!"

"You won't feel cold after you reach the third or fourth level of Qi refining."

Li Yingling silently looked sideways at the magical secret book lying next to him - the Water Heart Sutra.

Master!What you said is really hard to believe!!

Dry!Die! Die!The master you choose will continue to practice with tears in your eyes.

Li Yingling gritted his teeth and stood up, picked up the Shui Xin Sutra and walked to the fire, opened the first page and looked at the first line.

[My Lord Shui Ling, this mental method is the exclusive secret skill of True Lord Shui Ling in the True Immortal Realm.】

Huo!True immortal mind method?

Li Yingling looked towards the second row in a slightly better mood.

[This is the True Lord of the Furious Waves, the True Water written by the True Lord of the Water Spirit!This seat has been modified!The effect is more powerful, everyone can practice with confidence!】

Huo!Is there anyone who can modify it thoughtfully?!

Li Yingling nodded with satisfaction and looked at the third row.

[I, Fanhai Zhenjun, the two above are useless, what the hell are you writing, they are misleading!This seat has been changed.】

………????

Li Yingling's eyes quickly scanned the first page.

Good guy!

The first page is all about the sentence at the beginning of this book, angrily criticizing the trash above, according to the first page.

This Water Heart Sutra has been modified by at least seventeen powerful men.

In other words, this is the spiritual method of cultivating immortality that has gone through seventeen versions.

Li Yingling turned to the next page tremblingly.

Don't change it again!

【My seat...】

Li Yingling felt his eyes darken, but he still endured and read on.
